description: Replace text in a UI input selected by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates. Pass an empty text to clear the field. Prefer refs or selectors after snapshot; use recordAs to keep sensitive text out of a recorded replay while sending it to the live app. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

androidDeviceAllowlist.description: Android serial allowlist used for device resolution.

device.description: Device name selector (a UDID belongs in udid, a serial in serial).

deviceTarget.description: Device target form. Maps to the CLI --target flag.

includeCost.description: Include per-command agent-cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) in structuredContent. Defaults to off; the default response shape is unchanged.

mcpOutputFormat.description: MCP text content format. Defaults to optimized agent-friendly text; use json for JSON text. Structured content is always returned separately.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

recordAs.description: When script recording is armed, send text to the live app but publish it as ${VAR}. Use an uppercase replay variable name such as PASSWORD.

responseLevel.description: Response verbosity: token-cheap digest / default (today) / full. Defaults to default; the default response shape is unchanged.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial selector.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

target.description: UI target. This is separate from deviceTarget, which selects the device form.

label.description: Optional human label for the ref.

text.description: Text to enter into the target. Pass "" to clear it.

udid.description: Apple device or simulator UDID; the selector that pins one device when several share a name.

verify.description: Capture cheap post-action evidence (AX digest, node counts, changedFromBefore) instead of a follow-up snapshot.

name: fill

outputSchema.description: Fill response. Android may return target-bound unconfirmed evidence when the exact app-owned field changed but formatting prevented raw equality.

nodeCount.description: Number of nodes in the original node tree when the response carries one.

runnerRoundTrips.description: Number of real runner round-trips made while serving the request.

wallClockMs.description: Total wall-clock time for the request in milliseconds.

delayMs.description: Delay between typed characters in milliseconds.

changedFromBefore.description: Whether the post-action digest differs from the pre-action capture digest. false is evidence, not failure. With surfaceChange present, no digest comparison is made: it reports that surface transition.

digest.description: Order-independent digest of the post-action node multiset.

foregroundApp.description: Foreground app bundle id or name, when the capture carries it.

interactiveNodeCount.description: Subset of nodeCount the platform reports as hittable.

nodeCount.description: Node count in the post-action interactive-only capture.

surfaceChange.description: Present when an in-place system surface (web sign-in or Apple Pay sheet) was presented over the app, or left it.

disclosure.description: Agent-facing sentence explaining the surface transition.

from.description: Surface the pre-action baseline described: a host bundle id, or app.

to.description: Surface the post-action capture describes: a host bundle id, or app.

maestroNonHittableCoordinateFallbackAllo.description: Whether the direct iOS Maestro coordinate fallback was allowed for this selector.

maestroNonHittableCoordinateFallbackUsed.description: Whether the direct iOS Maestro coordinate fallback was actually used.

ref.description: Snapshot ref without the @ prefix when the target was an @ref.

referenceHeight.description: Reference frame height for visualizing the interaction point.

referenceWidth.description: Reference frame width for visualizing the interaction point.

resolution.description: Pre-action disclosure of how the acting path resolved its target. Absent when resolutionDisclosure is inapplicable for the path.

alternatives.description: At most 5 losing candidates, document order. Present at default/full response levels and omitted in digest. The winner is never included.

diagnosticRef.description: Opaque non-@ diagnostic token. Never a snapshot ref: not issued via refsGeneration and cannot be pinned or reused as an @ref target. UTF-8 truncated to 256 bytes.

matchCount.description: Total matches resolveSelectorChain found before disambiguation.

tiebreak.description: The comparison that decided the winner.

ref.description: Plain ref body (e12) for added lines.

truncated.description: Lines were capped to the response bound.

ref.description: Plain ref body (e12) minted from the stored settled tree.

refsGeneration.description: Snapshot generation of the stored settled tree; refs on added diff lines were minted from it.
